regions.cleaned_text: God bless you and yours. I hope you are all well -"Granma" Granpa" and all. I started half a dozen times since January 1st to write a let- ter worth while ..... 19 letters broke my record To-day - with a few bunches untouched since last week. . I was for a week's retreat down with Fr. M.E. in Huntington early in Oct. He is well and was trans- ferred to 226 E. 113th St. , N.Y. City. leaving here 15th. Mary Casey was here last evening is well. Frances Malloy's are all well. Ed. Sampson and Noonans are all well.
